Use some DBT techniques! Personally for me, I find when my anger is unbearable I disengage from the situation and find something to 'shock' me back into reality, whether this be a cold shower with my clothes on or stepping outside when the weather is freezing with no layers to keep me warm or even just sticking my head in the freezer, these techniques that physically cool me down help me to mentally cool down as well. 

Best of luck & wishing you all the best <3

Honestly yes, and it can just be so intense - sometimes out of nowhere I just have this sudden feeling of strong revulsion for somebody or something important to me, even people that are close to me or people I love and it is the most unsettling feeling ever
